policy: MP3/MP4 originals are unchanged except ambient.port, normalized +10 dB from its archive source. Processed entries have explicit source_bytes/source_sha256 and runtime_bytes/runtime_sha256; bytes/sha256 on unchanged entries identify both source and runtime. Exact SHA-256 duplicates share one asset. Five chapter themes are the global application background selected by current story chapter and continue across screens. Filename matching supplies presentation only, never game rules. Generated entries are separate original procedural effects, explicitly marked status=generated with their own source provenance; they are not members of the 95-entry archive.
